note: Frozen after the 12-item technical smoke test and BEFORE any full-run behaviour or probe result was seen.

model.kernels: transformers pure-PyTorch fallbacks for gated-delta-rule and causal-conv1d (fla/causal_conv1d not installed)

behaviour.interface: forced choice: total teacher-forced log-prob of continuation '<LABEL>\n' for each of ALLOW/DENY/REQUEST_EVIDENCE/ESCALATE; decision=argmax; margin=top-second; confidence=softmax over the 4 totals (max)
behaviour.distinct_from: earlier Ollama Q4_K_M free-generation labels (NOT reused)
behaviour.invalid_outputs: forced choice cannot be invalid; generation-subset INVALID/AMBIGUOUS reported separately and never counted as authorization errors

extraction.site: decoder-block output (residual stream) via forward hook; equals hidden_states[b+1] for b<31; block 31 is PRE final norm (hidden_states[32] is post-norm in HF)
extraction.primary_representation: last prompt token (end of generation prompt, before any answer token)

analysis_sets.exploratory_stress: dual wording (432 items): scope-ambiguous existential dual and polarity-ambiguous 'policy satisfied' label wording (reports/14) — reported separately

probe.inner_cv: GroupKFold(4) on training scenarios for C selection
probe.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted inside each training fold
probe.shuffled_label_control: 100 permutations of labels across items, same pipeline (Task A: 20 permutations for runtime)

baselines_task_B: structured input features (family, condition, completeness flag, pivot rank, prompt length; one-hot)
TF-IDF of user prompt (1-2 grams, fitted in fold) + L2 logistic
output confidence (max softmax over 4 label totals)
metrics: all layers x both representations reported
stopping: fewer than 30 errors in the primary set (Task B not meaningful)
